tools.name: propertyware_list_buildings
tools.description: List Propertyware buildings. One page; use next (preserves filters) for the following call. Requires BUILDINGS read permission.

tools.name: propertyware_get_building
tools.description: Get one Propertyware building by ID.

tools.name: propertyware_get_unit

tools.name: propertyware_get_lease
tools.description: Get one Propertyware lease by ID.

tools.name: propertyware_get_contact

tools.name: propertyware_get_portfolio

tools.name: propertyware_list_building_notes
tools.description: Read notes for one Propertyware building. The vendor does not paginate this endpoint.

tools.name: propertyware_list_lease_notes
tools.description: Read notes for one Propertyware lease. The vendor does not paginate this endpoint.

tools.name: propertyware_list_work_order_tasks
tools.description: List tasks on one work order; next preserves filters for the next page.

tools.name: propertyware_create_work_order_task
tools.description: WRITE: Add a task to an existing work order. Requires WORK ORDERS write permission. Creates a new task on each call; do not retry blindly.

tools.name: propertyware_add_task_comment
tools.description: WRITE: Add a comment to an existing work order task. May be visible to other users with task access. Repeating the call creates duplicate comments.
